title: Ghana Reappoints Ex‑Bafana Coach, Young Africans Unveil New Kits & Burnley’s MLS Transfer Talk
flags: The kits will debut in the Tanzanian Premier League (TPL) next week, and the club hopes the fresh look will translate into on‑field confidence.
Burnley are reportedly finalising a deal with a Major League Soccer side for striker Lyle Foster, with a fee pegged around $7 million (≈ R 130 million).
The article notes that the player has “turned down” interest from clubs in Germany and France, making the MLS move the most likely outcome.
